scope: Owned headless DSH with installed Deck host8: one generated PCM WAV and one locally generated H264/AAC clip; system audio muted.
checks: actual WAV and H264/AAC media embedded byte-for-byte in native source
actual WebAudio output callback emitted nonzero samples while muted externally
native source and exported PPTX reopen with the original audio and video bytes
H264 video produced colored, changing pixels in the actual Deck canvas
limits: Only these sample formats and the observed browser audio graph/video frames were tested.
An independent desktop PowerPoint consumer and every codec, animation, master and font interchange were not verified.
